title: Affine base case in source-open comparison coordinates
statement: Let X'→X, S'→S be a cartesian square of schemes with S,S' affine [def-pc-scheme]. Let K,K' have quasi-coherent derived cohomology and φ:L(g')*K→K' [def-pc-derived-category]. Assume the canonical single-complex stalk condition [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. For every affine open U of X, the explicit restricted comparison b_U [def-pc-single-complex-open-comparison] is an isomorphism. No quasi-compactness or quasi-separatedness assumption on the entire morphism f is required.

proof.text: Paste the canonical source-open pullback square with sq, using IsPullback.flip.paste_vert. U is affine by hU; since g is affine, IsAffine.of_isPullback makes its inverse-image scheme affine.

Use derivedPullback_tensor_preserve_QCoh for U.ι and pullback.fst to obtain quasi-coherent cohomology of the two restricted coefficient objects. Define the restricted coefficient map by the exact expression used in singleComplexOpenComparison. Apply the open stalk-condition transport lemma to this restricted square.

Construct the spectrum square by IsPullback.of_iso with the four canonical isoSpec maps and Scheme.isoSpec_hom_naturality. Apply the spectrum-coordinate transport lemma to this square. Obtain the coefficient objects and map, their quasi-coherence, the transported stalk condition, and the two endpoint isomorphisms with their commuting equation.

Apply singleComplexAffineBaseChange to the four global-section rings and the maps induced by the restricted square. Derived pullback along S′.toSpecΓ preserves this isomorphism. Rewrite the original comparison by the commuting equation and compose the resulting isomorphism with the two endpoint isomorphisms.

proof_origin.place: Affine-open paragraph: explicit restricted square, spectrum-coordinate transport, and existing affine criterion; two transport lemmas split off by C1
